location: Uptown, Central City, Broadmoor & the CBD
heroIntro: Councilmember {councilDisplayName} and {influencerIntro} are supporting District {district}'s hospitality businesses this summer with a special night out to three local favorites across Uptown, Central City, Broadmoor and the Central Business District!
Vote to decide {councilFirstName} & {influencerFirstName}'s last stop of the night & become a Local Legend by checking in at neighborhood restaurants, bars, music venues and more all summer long!
councilQuote: This isn't just about nightlife; it's about connecting with the community where they are. We're breaking down the walls of City Hall.
influencerQuote: District {district} has some of the most vibrant, unsung spots in the city. I can't wait to show everyone what makes this neighborhood tick.

winner.summaryBody: Hot & Soul is serving a wide, even eclectic, array of culinary treats in Mid-City. Kudos to these neighborhood champs!

stops.title: {influencerName}'s Sundown Wind-Down
stops.body: The crawl begins at a spot {influencerName} calls essential�live energy, strong pours, and the kind of room that sets the tone for the whole night.
stops.runoffBody: Where Chef Juan works his magic, blending the bold flavors of Peru with the soulful depth of Louisiana Creole cooking. Come for the ceviche, the Pisco, the color - all rooted in heritage, family, friends and community.
stops.address: 1433 St Charles Ave, New Orleans, LA 70130

stops.title: {councilName}'s Mystery Pick
stops.body: Councilmember {councilName} takes the group to a trusted institution where regulars, workers, and visitors mix�perfect for talking policy without leaving the party behind.
stops.runoffBody: Across the spectrum of vibes on offer at District B's restaurants, bars and venues, Councilmember Harris is spotlighting a neighborhood bar focused on community in the heart of Uptown - QiQi. A place for queer pride, open ears, open hearts and good times!

stops.title: The District B Vote
stops.body: The final stop is yours. Vote now to send the crawl to the {location} venue you want on the map when we roll through on August 5.
